qt: to the Commission Raffaele Topo (S&D), Lucia Annunziata (S&D), Sandro Ruotolo (S&D), Georgia Tramacere (S&D), Giuseppe Lupo (S&D) Subject:

The Campi Flegrei area, and in particular the municipality of Pozzuoli, has been facing ongoing bradyseismic and seismic activity, which, over the last years, has highlighted just how vulnerable the area and local communities are. In view of the volcanic nature of the area and the combination of both bradyseismic and seismic activity, there is a need to step up monitoring, safety and emergency preparedness measures, also with a view to reducing the exposure of the population and infrastructure to risks. The ERDF programme for Campania for 2021-2027 explicitly identifies seismic and volcanic risks under Specific Objective 2.4 and Action 2.4.2. In view of the above: 1.

What support can the Commission provide to the Campania Region to help fully mobilise available ERDF resources to strengthen the resilience efforts of the Campi Flegrei area and the municipality of Pozzuoli in particular?
Does it think that the flexibility provided by the RESTORE framework can, where applicable, be used to support recovery, reconstruction and resilience-building measures in the Campi Flegrei area?
Will it work with the Italian and regional authorities to facilitate its use in that area?
